article_FAQ-0237.a:
Mawaqif Parking Payment Methods

1. Mawaqif Machines

Accept coins only

2. SMS Payment

Send an SMS to 3009 using the following format:

AUH00 0000 P/S 1

Shortcuts for UAE Emiratis: AUH, DXB, SHJ, AJM, FUJ, UAQ, RAK

For GCC plates

Saudi: KSA, SAU

Kuwait: KWT

Bahrain: BHR, BAH

Oman: OMN

Qatar: QAT

Note: SMS payment is only for private vehicles. Other vehicle types must use the Darb app, website, or Mawaqif machines

Important Notes for SMS Payments

Must have a valid SIM card (postpaid or prepaid)

Postpaid: Ensure sufficient credit and that you haven’t reached your hard cap limit

Prepaid: Ensure you haven’t reached your hard cap limit and activate the M-Parking wallet by contacting your network provider

Network codes

Etisalat: 101

Du: 155

Virgin: 165

4. Third-Party Applications

Darb App: Sign in, Home screen, Select Paying for parking

TAMM App: Sign in, My TAMM, Select Pay for parking

First 30 daysAED 100/day30 × AED 100 = AED 3,000
Day 31 onwardsAED 500/month (not per day)15 days into month 2 = AED 500

Total for 45 days = AED 3,000 + AED 500 = AED 3,500

Common mistake to avoid: Do NOT calculate AED 100/day for all 45 days (= AED 4,500). The rate changes to AED 500/month after day 30. Once the calendar month begins (day 31+), the full monthly rate of AED 500 applies for any portion of that month.

article_INT-POD-TOWING.q: PoD permit holder vehicle towed — are they exempt from towing fee?
article_INT-POD-TOWING.a:
⚠ NO — PoD permit does NOT exempt from towing fees.

The correct agent response when a PoD permit holder claims exemption from the AED 500 towing fee:

"The standard towing fee of AED 500 is mandated by law, cannot be waived regardless of permit type, and must be paid in full before vehicle release. PoD permits provide designated free parking, not immunity from towing fees for unauthorized parking."

Key Points

  • AED 500 towing fee = legally mandated, cannot be waived by anyone
  • PoD permits grant free designated parking spaces — not blanket exemption from enforcement
  • If the vehicle was in an unauthorized zone, the tow is valid and fee applies
  • PoD status does NOT automatically result in fee waiver via grievance
  • Do NOT escalate to supervisor as "no policy" — the policy is clear: fee is mandatory
What PoD permits DO provide: Designated free parking spaces (usually larger, accessible). Parking in those designated spaces is free. Parking outside those spaces, especially in unauthorized areas, is still subject to normal enforcement including towing.

article_OLD-RESIDENT-PERMIT-GUIDE.a:
Resident Permit — Old KB Guide

Application channels: TAMM platform or Darb application.

Required documents

  • Tenancy contract approved by municipality / ownership contract.
  • Latest water and electricity bill from the last 3 months, or ADDC NOC if no bill is available.
  • Vehicle ownership / Mulkiya.
  • If the vehicle is rented: vehicle rental contract or a letter proving the vehicle is rented for 6 months or more.
  • If the vehicle is allocated by employer: vehicle allocation letter from the employer.
  • If there is a name mismatch between the vehicle owner and the tenancy contract: proof of first- or second-degree relation only.

Important notes

  • The applicant must be the permit owner, tenant, or a first/second-degree relative.
  • If the name differs between the tenancy contract and utility bill, the customer must submit an exception request through TAMM.
  • If the customer has previous Mawaqif fines and applies for a resident permit, the total amount may include previous fines and must be followed up.

article_OLD-RECHARGEABLE-CARD-FAQ.q: Old KB — Rechargeable parking card closure FAQ and Darb wallet replacement
article_OLD-RECHARGEABLE-CARD-FAQ.kw: rechargeable card parking card closed wallet darb balance transfer بطاقة قابلة للشحن محفظة درب
article_OLD-RECHARGEABLE-CARD-FAQ.a:
Rechargeable Card Closure — Old KB FAQ

The rechargeable card feature was closed as part of improving user experience and simplifying payment methods.

Agent answers

  • Customers should now use the Darb app to manage parking balance and payments.
  • Old rechargeable-card balance can be transferred to the Darb wallet through the supported channel.
  • Customers can log in using UAE Pass and use the wallet balance within their account.
  • Wallet recharge can be done through the Darb app.
  • No additional fees are applied for using the Darb app; standard service fees remain applicable.

Benefits of using Darb wallet

  • Secure wallet balance management.
  • Faster payment experience.
  • Instant balance updates.
  • No need to keep a separate rechargeable parking card.

article_OLD-COURT-FINES-REQUIREMENTS.a:
Court / Locked Fines — Old KB Requirements

When a customer contacts about court-related fines, request supporting documents by email.

Required documents

  • Judgment text / court judgment copy.
  • Payment receipt from court.
  • Violation statement stamped by Traffic Prosecution.
  • Total number of violations in the judgment must match the violations attached in the statement.

If submitted through branch

  • Raise a complaint.
  • Mention the branch visit date.
  • Mention the case number.

article_OLD-OLD-OWNER-VIOLATIONS.q: Old KB — Violations under previous owner
article_OLD-OLD-OWNER-VIOLATIONS.kw: old owner previous owner violations vehicle data certificate traffic department مخالفات على مالك قديم شهادة بيانات مركبة
article_OLD-OLD-OWNER-VIOLATIONS.a:
Violations Under Previous Owner — Old KB Guide

If there are old violations under a previous owner, ask the customer to visit the Traffic Department and obtain a Vehicle Data Certificate, then submit it through the required QMobility / branch process.

The certificate is used to prove that the vehicle was not under the current customer’s name at the time of receiving the violation, so the violation can be transferred to the previous owner where applicable.

article_OLD-MAINTENANCE-RESERVATIONS.q: Old KB — Public parking reservations for maintenance works

article_OLD-MAINTENANCE-RESERVATIONS.a:
Public Parking Reservation — Maintenance Works

  • Infrastructure expansion and parking reservation service may require a refundable deposit shown in old KB as AED 1,000, refunded after project completion.
  • Infrastructure / expansion and maintenance-company reservations are used for work areas without reservation boards.
  • All business activities are chargeable except works assigned by government entities.
  • Emergency maintenance can be started and the request submitted as soon as possible.
  • If PDM boards are within the work scope, request removal through TAMM.
  • If the maintenance is on the sidewalk, submit a sidewalk reservation request.
  • If the maintenance is on public parking, submit a parking reservation request.
  • If work covers both sidewalk and public parking, both requests are required.
  • Expansion parking spaces within expansion projects may be free until construction completion.

article_OLD-SCHOOL-PARKING-TIMES.kw: school parking times Abu Dhabi Al Ain schools exceptions وقت المدارس مواقف المدارس
article_OLD-SCHOOL-PARKING-TIMES.a:
School Parking — Old KB Guide

School parking is regulated around schools in Abu Dhabi and Al Ain.

Abu Dhabi

  • Free parking period in the morning from 7:00 AM to 9:00 AM.
  • Free parking period after noon from 12:00 PM to 4:00 PM.

Al Ain

  • Parking payment applies around schools starting from 8:00 AM until 11:59 PM according to the old KB note.

Exceptions

No exceptions are available. Vehicles are not allowed to park free outside the approved periods without paying applicable fees.

article_OLD-FINES-SCENARIO-SCRIPTS.q: Old KB — Mawaqif fine handling scripts: sector, verify fine, grievance, impound, grace, prayer time
article_OLD-FINES-SCENARIO-SCRIPTS.kw: fine scripts verify fine sector not under mawaqif grievance impound grace period prayer time customer script سيناريو مخالفات
article_OLD-FINES-SCENARIO-SCRIPTS.a:
Mawaqif Fine Scripts — Old KB Flow

Fine in sector not under Mawaqif

Ask for the fine number or plate number. If issued by Mirsad / non-Mawaqif authority, provide the Smart Sector Map link and advise the customer to contact the relevant authority.

Verify fine

Ask for the fine number or plate number, confirm the sector and reason, then guide the customer to the branch if photos/location are required.

Grievance follow-up / rejection delay

Ask for fine number or plate number. If within SLA, advise the customer it may take up to 7 working days. If rejected or complex, guide to ITC / relevant authority where applicable.

Vehicle impounded

Ask for fine number or plate number. Check impound location and advise the customer to contact Emirates Auctions / relevant yard when required.

Grace-period fine

Explain that the grace period applies only for the first ticket issuance and not after expiry of a previous ticket.

Prayer-time fine

Explain that prayer-time exemption applies only in mosque-designated parking areas.

article_OLD-COMPLAINT-FOLLOWUP-SCRIPTS.q: Old KB — Complaint follow-up scripts and exceeded SLA wording

article_OLD-COMPLAINT-FOLLOWUP-SCRIPTS.a:
Complaint Follow-up Scripts — Old KB

Follow-up on Mawaqif complaint

Ask for the complaint reference number. If it was submitted recently, advise that the case may take up to 7 working days for resolution.

Complaint exceeded SLA

Ask for the complaint reference number, confirm that the case exceeded the estimated time, and escalate to the concerned department for immediate action.

Calls not related to Mawaqif

Apologize politely and advise the customer to contact the appropriate entity for services not related to QMobility / Mawaqif.

article_OLD-PUBLIC-PARKING-SCRIPTS.q: Old KB — Public parking payment scripts: UAE plates, GCC plates, PDM no receipt, non-private plates
article_OLD-PUBLIC-PARKING-SCRIPTS.kw: public parking scripts UAE GCC plate SMS 3009 PDM no receipt non private plate green yellow commercial دفع المواقف
article_OLD-PUBLIC-PARKING-SCRIPTS.a:
Public Parking Payment Scripts — Old KB

Pay for parking in Abu Dhabi by SMS

For UAE private vehicles, ask the customer to send SMS to 3009 using the approved format, e.g. AUH10 12345 S 1.

GCC vehicles

Use GCC country short codes such as KSA/SAU, KWT, BHR/BAH, OMN, QAT.

SMS failed

Check SMS format, sufficient credit / hard cap, and whether the SIM is allowed to use M-Parking wallet with the telecom provider.

PDM payment with no receipt

Ask for machine number, car number, date/time of payment, and customer email, then raise the request.

Commercial / green / yellow plates

Payment should be done through PDM or Darb app only where SMS is not supported.

article_OLD-DARB-TRAFFIC-NUMBER-SCRIPTS.q: Old KB — Add traffic number / TC number scripts in Darb
article_OLD-DARB-TRAFFIC-NUMBER-SCRIPTS.kw: add traffic number TC number Darb account wrong TC already exists same owner another person prayer time fine scripts
article_OLD-DARB-TRAFFIC-NUMBER-SCRIPTS.a:
Add Traffic Number — Old KB Scripts

Wrong TC number used

Confirm which TC number was used. If the customer used the driving licence TC instead of vehicle registration TC, advise them to use the TC number on the car registration card.

Request already exists

Confirm plate/fine number and explain the fine reason. If photos are needed, guide to the branch.

Same owner

Guide the customer to add the traffic number under the same Darb account where applicable.

Another person

If adding traffic number for another person / POD related case, guide customer through the correct owner/relative process and verify required documents.

article_OLD-DARB-ACCOUNT-SCRIPTS.a:
Darb Account Creation Scripts — Old KB

Individual account

Ask whether the account is for an individual or establishment. For individuals, advise using Darb app / platform and logging in with UAE Pass.

Establishment account

Ask for company name and trade licence number. The customer may need access to the mobile number registered under the company to verify OTP.

No mobile phone number retrieved

Ask for the TC number and confirm the full company name / trade licence number. If the mobile number retrieved belongs to another company, the customer must have access to that number or update the registered contact details before OTP verification.

article_OFFICIAL-DARB-FEES-2026-04-30.q: Official Darb toll fees, registration fee, and gate timing
article_OFFICIAL-DARB-FEES-2026-04-30.a:
Darb registration is AED 100 per vehicle: AED 50 registration fee and AED 50 credited to the wallet.

Sas Al Nakhl, Al Maqta, Rabdan, and Al Saadiyat gates charge AED 4 per crossing during peak hours: 7:00 AM-9:00 AM and 3:00 PM-7:00 PM, except Sundays and official holidays.

Al Qurm and Ghantout toll gates operate 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.

article_OFFICIAL-MAWAQIF-RATES-2026-04-3.q: Official Mawaqif public parking rates and paid hours
article_OFFICIAL-MAWAQIF-RATES-2026-04-3.a:
Standard public parking is AED 2 per hour, capped at AED 15 for 24 hours. Premium parking is AED 3 per hour, with a maximum stay of 4 hours.

Paid public parking hours are Monday to Saturday from 8:00 AM to 12:00 AM midnight. Parking is free on Sundays and public holidays.

Payment methods include Darb mobile app, parking meters, and SMS.

Source: Q Mobility Mawaqif FAQ.

Work on the Parking Bay: It is recommended to submit a request for Parking Bay Reservation.

The Administration may reserve parking spaces for specific entities upon request, divided into Free and Paid allocations as follows:

1 & 2 Star Hotels: 1 Free / 2 Paid.

Note: Furnished apartments operating under the hotel system are treated the same as 1-2 star hotels.

3 Star Hotels: 2 Free / 3 Paid.

6. If you receive a Mawaqif fine, you will not receive another fine for the same reason and in the same sector on the same day.

7. Prayer time exemption is available only in mosque parking areas. It is valid for 45 minutes starting from the first call to prayer (Adhan).

8. The grace period is allowed only once per day before paying the first parking ticket. It is valid for 10 minutes only. If you already have a ticket and it expires, a fine will be issued immediately once the vehicle is detected by a smart vehicle or inspector.

9. If you change your vehicle number and it is registered in the Darb toll system, you must submit a request through the Darb app by following these steps:

Login → Requests → Complaints → tap the (+) sign → submit a request.

If using the website, submit a vehicle registration complaint and attach both the old and new vehicle registration cards.

10. If you change the vehicle but keep the same plate number, you must pay again to register the new vehicle in the Darb toll system.

11. Darb toll fines have a grace period of 10 working days from the crossing time. For non-Abu Dhabi vehicles, if the vehicle is registered but has insufficient balance, a grace period of 5 working days is given to pay the unpaid toll fees.

12. Toll fees cannot be paid without Darb registration. Registration is mandatory for users who pass through DARB gates and is available online through the Darb website or app.

13. The Darb toll gate does not require any card or badge. Only online registration is required.

14. Individuals may use the DARB app or website. Establishment accounts must use the DARB website.

article_OPS-2026-0918-L1-DOCUMENT-CHECKL.q: What documents must I confirm before submitting a parking or permit application (L1 checklist)?
article_OPS-2026-0918-L1-DOCUMENT-CHECKL.a:

1. Freight & light cargo vehicle parking (3–5 ton light trucks)

  • Official email or request letter from the applying entity
  • Valid commercial licence (trade licence)
  • Exact GPS coordinates of the proposed location
  • Nearest prominent landmark

2. Commercial loading and unloading bays

  • Valid commercial licence matching the qualifying commercial activity
  • Clear operational justification and sector location details
  • All elements and criteria in the reference guide

3. People of Determination (accessible) parking

  • Valid PoD card issued by the Zayed Higher Organization only
  • Valid Emirates ID and vehicle registration card (Mulkiya)
  • Proof of residence / tenancy contract
  • Verification that no suitable accessible space is already available nearby

4. Temporary entrance requests (workshop & commercial owners)

  • Musaffah Industrial Area: restricted to workshops, car washes and commercial shops requiring direct vehicle ingress/egress. Trade licence and activity details required.
  • Al Ain City: commercial licence and full activity description required for the Permits Section to evaluate.

Run the completeness check before you submit. Use the approved Salesforce categories and descriptions so the case routes correctly. Never write or say “the concerned department” — always represent Q Mobility as one team.

To process this we need the following documents. Once they are all attached we will raise the request, and it is resolved within 3 working days.

article_OPS-2026-0807-COMPLAINT-DIGITAL-.q: A customer wants to raise a complaint - do I raise it for them?
article_OPS-2026-0807-COMPLAINT-DIGITAL-.a:

Required process

  1. Explain the available digital complaint channel to the customer.
  2. Guide the customer on how to submit the complaint through it.

When you may raise it directly

Only where the customer insists after being guided, or there is a genuine reason preventing them from using the digital channel.

article_MAW-2026-0811-COMPANY-VEHICLE-GR.q: How does a customer submit a Mawaqif fine grievance for a company vehicle via TAMM?
article_MAW-2026-0811-COMPANY-VEHICLE-GR.a:
Direct answer: through TAMM, using the Grievance for Transport Violations service. This route applies only to vehicles registered under a company name, and the grievance may be submitted from any TAMM account provided the violation is linked to a company-owned vehicle.

Steps

  1. Log in to the TAMM account.
  2. In the search bar, search for “Grievance for Transport Violations”.
  3. Select New Application.
  4. Choose My Profile and click Next.
  5. From the Violation Type drop-down, select Public Parking (Mawaqif).
  6. Enter the violation number and click Show Details.
  7. Review the violation details and submit the grievance.
Agent action
For a company-owned vehicle do not tell the customer they must log in as the vehicle owner — any TAMM account works as long as the violation is linked to the company vehicle. For privately owned vehicles, use the standard owner-account grievance route.
Tell the customer
For a company vehicle you can submit the grievance from your own TAMM account. Search for “Grievance for Transport Violations”, choose New Application, select Public Parking (Mawaqif), and enter the violation number.

Your vehicle is still on a temporary plate. Please complete the transfer to a permanent plate so the Mawaqif system recognises it, otherwise parking payments will not register and fines will continue to be issued.

article_OPS-2026-0901-WHATSAPP-SESSION-R.q: Why can I not start or continue a WhatsApp chat with a customer?
article_OPS-2026-0901-WHATSAPP-SESSION-R.a:
Direct answer: WhatsApp messaging is governed by Meta policy. You can message a customer freely only inside the session that opens once the customer initiates or replies. Where the customer has not replied, you may only send Meta-approved WhatsApp templates.

This restriction comes from Meta/WhatsApp and cannot be bypassed or removed by Q Mobility.

Known issue

Numbers stored with a 00 prefix instead of + currently fail when starting a chat. A fix to the phone number format is in progress with the technical teams.

Agent action
If the customer has not replied, use an approved template rather than a free-text message. If the number starts with 00 and the chat will not open, correct the format or use another channel, and report the number so it can be fixed.
Tell the customer
I have sent you a message on WhatsApp — please reply to it so I can continue helping you there.

article_MAW-2026-0915-CAR-SHOWROOM-PARKI.q: What are the parking rules for car showrooms?
article_MAW-2026-0915-CAR-SHOWROOM-PARKI.a:
Direct answer: a showroom may use the bays in front of and opposite the showroom and the sandy lots around it, provided every vehicle carries valid traffic plates, parking rules and fees are observed, and traffic is not obstructed.

Permitted

  • Parking in the bays in front of and opposite the showroom, for showroom vehicles that carry plates and an official plate bearing the showroom name.
  • Parking outside the showroom where the vehicle carries valid traffic plates, parking regulations are followed and fees are paid.
  • Parking on the sandy lots around the showroom, in an orderly manner, without exceeding the showroom’s own area and without obstructing traffic.

To avoid

  • Parking at intersections and exits
  • Parking outside the showroom without an official plate
  • Concealing traffic plates
  • Unofficial stickers
  • Using public parking as a permanent showroom
  • Placing barriers or reservation markers
  • Leaving neglected or damaged vehicles
Agent action
This official Mawaqif brochure was distributed to car showrooms in Al Ain and circulated to the Contact Centre. The Arabic brochure is the authority for exact wording — for a formal or disputed question, refer the customer to it rather than paraphrasing.
Tell the customer
Showroom vehicles may use the bays in front of and opposite the showroom and the sandy lots around it, as long as every vehicle carries valid plates, parking fees are paid and traffic is not obstructed. Vehicles must not block intersections or exits, hide plates, or be left neglected or damaged.

article_OPS-2026-0911-TOWED-STATUS-MANUA.q: TEMPORARY: CRM shows a vehicle as untowed but the customer says it was towed - what do I do?
article_OPS-2026-0911-TOWED-STATUS-MANUA.a:
Direct answer: do not rely on the CRM status alone. A system issue affecting the Enforcement Stage means vehicles in Abu Dhabi, Musaffah and Al Ain are temporarily being processed manually, so a towed vehicle can still show as untowed.

What to do

  1. Check the current manually-towed vehicle list circulated by Parking Operations.
  2. If the vehicle is on it, handle the case as a towed vehicle.
  3. If it is not, escalate to your supervisor before telling the customer the vehicle was not towed.
Agent action
Never confirm “your vehicle was not towed” from the CRM status while this is in force. The issue is with the IT team; there is no confirmed fix date.
Tell the customer
Let me check this for you — our system is currently being updated manually for towed vehicles, so I want to confirm the status before I give you an answer.
